portals.name: Juniper Square Investor Portal

web.notes: One Juniper Square login reused across every sponsor portal (700k+ investors). 2FA available to investors, methods not stated. SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) for enterprise GP users.

api.notes: GP-side REST API and webhooks aligned with OpenAPI, sales-led, no public reference docs. No LP-facing API. A headless LP portal is on the vendor roadmap.

mcp.notes: Headless GPX MCP server, live with select customers since June 2026, read-only tools (contacts, accounts, positions, documents, transactions). GP-side only. Endpoint and auth not published. Not in the official MCP registry.

sftp.notes: Inbound only, for administrators and GPs posting statements into Juniper Square.

terms.notes: End User Terms and Website Terms prohibit scraping, robots and other automated queries without prior written permission, and sharing passwords with advisers.

portals.notes: High confidence (vendor pages 2026-11-07): GP-side REST API, webhooks, inbound SFTP and a read-only MCP server exist, all sales-led and not offered to investors. Also sold as a fund administration service on the same platform. LP access is the web portal with 2FA. Unknown: LP email notification behaviour, MCP endpoint and auth.

portals.name: Carta LP Portal

web.notes: Single LP login across all funds administered on Carta. 2FA set up at registration; methods not confirmed. Multi-select download of K-1s, capital notices and annual reports.

api.notes: Public docs and a mock server; production access requires Carta approval. Suites: Launch, Investor (portfolio cap-table data for fund operators), Issuer, Portfolio, CRM. No LP self-serve path for fund-account data found.

mcp.notes: Vendor remote MCP server, Anthropic-verified connector since May 2026. Tools include discover, fetch, list_accounts, cap_table_chart. Fund performance and accounting data for investors are mentioned; documents and capital calls are not. LP coverage unconfirmed.

sftp.notes: Only for the separate Carta LP Portfolio Analytics product (formerly Accelex).

email_notifications.notes: Capital call notices emailed from investor-notices@carta.com with a link into the portal.

terms.notes: Terms page returned HTTP 403 to the researcher.

portals.notes: High confidence: public API docs with sandbox, production gated; vendor MCP server with OAuth sign-in. Carta also runs a fund administration service on this platform. Unknown: whether an LP can use the MCP server or an API scope for their own commitments; terms on automation.

portals.name: Allvue Investor Portal

web.notes: Branded GP portal. SSO and MFA not stated.

api.notes: Nexius Data Platform described as API-first (real-time APIs, bulk extraction, Snowflake, flat files) for client teams. No public developer docs.

mcp.notes: Agentic AI platform page does not mention MCP.

portals.notes: High confidence: portal delivers capital call and distribution notices, reports, capital account statements, K-1s. GP-side APIs exist but are undocumented publicly. No LP-side programmatic access identified.

portals.name: eFront Investment Café

web.notes: Hosted browser portal, deployed per GP or administrator, so investors meet many separate instances. SSO and MFA not stated.

api.notes: Press material cites API capabilities for sync with the eFront back office. No public docs. Also distributed by Apex Group.

portals.notes: BlackRock-owned since 2019. Widely used by European GPs and administrators, including Aztec Group for its investor reporting portal. 56m+ documents shared with investors per vendor. No LP-side programmatic access identified. See registry/deployments.json for known deployments.

portals.name: Dynamo Investor Portal

web.notes: Investor Portal v3.0 (2024) with tax document centre and e-consent.

api.notes: API exists for customers per review sites and vendor pages; no public docs.

email_notifications.notes: Configurable notifications for new messages and documents (medium confidence).

portals.notes: Medium confidence overall: vendor site blocked automated fetches, facts from press and review listings. Portal is a window onto the Dynamo CRM.

portals.name: Backstop Client Portal

web.notes: Branded reporting portal with PDF watermarking and download tracking.

api.notes: Specially licensed REST APIs for Backstop customers, sales-led, no public docs. No API for an LP to pull from a GP's Client Portal.

portals.notes: Legacy name InvestorBridge. Backstop also sells IntellX to allocators, which retrieves documents from fund emails and GP portals on the allocator's behalf.

portals.name: Altvia ShareSecure

web.notes: 2FA, encryption, dynamic watermarks. SSO not mentioned.

mcp.notes: Press (May 2026) reports MCP access for GP teams. Not confirmed on vendor site.

email_notifications.notes: LPs notified of capital calls, distributions and reports on posting.

portals.notes: Combined data room and LP portal. No LP-side programmatic access identified.

portals.name: FIS Digital Data Exchange

web.notes: Self-service, brandable portal with e-signing, documents and capital event monitoring.

api.notes: Private Capital Suite (formerly Investran) integrates via API or File Utility, GP and administrator side.

portals.notes: Investor portal companion to FIS Private Capital Suite (Investran), re-platformed as cloud SaaS in 2025. No LP-side programmatic access identified.

portals.name: S&P Global iLEVEL

web.notes: Portfolio monitoring for GPs and LPs, with the Prism LP portal for sharing documents.

api.notes: Customer-only REST API used by integration vendors. No public docs.

mcp.notes: MCP server for iLEVEL customers announced October 2026. No public endpoint or docs.

portals.notes: Many LPs are iLEVEL customers themselves, in which case API and MCP are available under their own contract.

portals.name: SS&C Investor Services Portal (GlobeOp)

web.notes: Single web portal across managers for investors of SS&C-administered funds (600k+ users). Statements as PDF.

portals.notes: Sibling SS&C portals: Intralinks FundCentre and InvestorVision. No LP-side programmatic access identified.

portals.name: SS&C Intralinks FundCentre

web.notes: One Intralinks login across GPs (170k+ individuals). SSO via professional services. Link AI assistant answers LP questions over approved documents.

api.notes: Library of APIs with Swagger docs behind engagement. Keys are customer-specific and may not be shared.

terms.notes: Terms prohibit bots, spiders, automated retrieval causing excessive usage, and sharing API keys or User IDs.

portals.notes: The LP portal product of SS&C Intralinks (the deal data room is a separate product). ILPA templates built in. Carta LP Portfolio Analytics documents vendor-arranged API access to Intralinks for automated retrieval.

portals.name: InvestorFlow Investor Portal

web.notes: Branded LP portal, enterprise IAM with SSO and MFA, dynamic watermarks.

email_notifications.notes: Notices via portal, email or both; LPs set preferences.

terms.notes: No robots, spiders or scraping; accounts may not be shared.

portals.notes: Salesforce-based. Ingests data from administrators such as SS&C, Citco, Apex and CSC.

portals.name: Cash Flow Portal

mcp.notes: CFP MCP for sponsor users, scoped to what they may see. LP use not described.

terms.notes: No access outside publicly supported interfaces, no credential sharing.

portals.notes: US real estate syndication portal, one of few LP portal vendors with a vendor-built MCP server.

portals.name: Chronograph LP

api.notes: GraphQL and REST APIs, keys for approved developers, sandbox, docs behind client login. Snowflake Secure Data Share.

mcp.notes: Anthropic-verified connector since November 2025. Tools: run-query, entity-search, commitment-history, investment-metrics, top-exposures.

terms.notes: Vendor provides API and MCP for client automation.

portals.notes: Not a GP-to-LP portal: an LP-side monitoring platform where the LP is the customer and GP documents are aggregated on its behalf. Listed because it is the strongest example of investor-side API plus MCP today.

portals.name: MSCI Private i (Burgiss)

api.notes: Private i Data API and Analytics API for authorised clients.

portals.notes: LP-side book of record and benchmarking platform (Burgiss, Caissa), not a GP portal. 30,100 funds covered per vendor.

assessments.rationale: LP side is web login with 2FA only. GP-side REST API, webhooks, SFTP and a read-only MCP server exist but are not offered to investors. Terms prohibit automated queries without written permission.

Publicly documented OAuth API with sandbox and a vendor MCP server, both oriented to fund managers and partners. LP access to own commitments via API or MCP unconfirmed. Email notices give a machine-readable trigger.
Web portal only for LPs. APIs are GP-side and undocumented publicly.
Hosted web portal per GP or administrator. API is back-office integration for GPs. No public docs, no MCP.
Web portal with email notifications. Vendor API for GP customers only, no public docs.
Web-only for investors. Licensed REST APIs serve Backstop's own customers.
LP portal with 2FA and email notifications. No public API. MCP for GP teams only.
Web portal. API and file utility integration is GP and administrator side.
Customer-only REST API and new MCP server for iLEVEL subscribers. LP access via the Prism portal unverified.
Web portal with PDF statements. No API, SFTP or MCP information published.
GP-side API behind engagement. LP side is web login. Terms prohibit bots and API-key sharing.
Web portal with configurable email notices. No public API. Terms prohibit scraping.
Vendor MCP server for sponsors. LP side is web login. Terms prohibit access outside supported interfaces.
The LP is the customer: GraphQL and REST API with keys and sandbox, Snowflake share, Excel exports, vendor MCP server. Not fully self-serve.
Data and Analytics APIs for authorised LP clients, no public docs, no MCP.
